# The beck language reference

*Generated by `beck doc reference` from the compiler's own tables. Do not edit: `.github/workflows/docs.yml` fails the build when this file and the compiler disagree.*

Every page here is derived from the compiler: the error index from the codes it can emit, the command reference from the parser that reads the arguments, the effect and tier tables from the predicate the placement solver evaluates, and the prelude from the schemes inference reads. Nothing on these pages is a transcription that can go stale without the build noticing.

The design documents — what Beck is, and why — are in [`docs/`](../README.md). This is the part a program is checked against.

- [Error index](errors.md) — every diagnostic code the compiler can emit, and what it means
- [Command reference](cli.md) — every `beck` subcommand, its arguments and its flags
- [Effects and tiers](effects.md) — the effect atoms, and which tier can discharge each
- [The prelude](prelude.md) — every name in scope in every module, with its inferred scheme
- [Forms of the language](forms.md) — the reserved heads, the two surfaces, and doc comments
